runs.text:
In the 25 years of their existence, Swedish metallers Sabaton have gained a reputation as one of the hardest working bands in the industry. They have delivered 10 highly-rated studio albums (including 2 certified platinum-sellers) & scored multiple industry awards & nominations. The band has accumulated +3 billion streams across all streaming platforms & +2 billion views on YouTube.

Combining soaring power riffs with vocalist Joakim Brodén’s instantly-recognisable gruff baritone, the band refuses to be simply slotted into a genre. Their legion of loyal fans across the globe only knows them as Sabaton: the heavy metal band that sings of real life wars & the people who played a part in them – of gruelling campaigns & acts of bravery, of magnificent victories & touching personal struggles – true stories more fantastic than any fiction!

Sabaton are perhaps best known for their electrifying live shows, combining accomplished musical performances & a finely-crafted stage show – including their full-sized tank drum-riser – with energy & laughter. The band has headlined as far afield as North America, Australia & Japan, & regularly fills arenas, taking top-billed slots at festivals across Europe. They are also a favourite support act for metal titans Iron Maiden & Scorpions. Sabaton’s live show has won top industry accolades in Germany (Metal Hammer Award), Sweden (Bandit Rock Award), as well as being nominated for two Metal Hammer Golden Gods awards in the UK.
